question: interior-finishes-to-schedule
unit: sum (whole interior finishes-schedule package for one 800 m2 tenancy floor; unit rates are $/m2, $/m and $/package as noted)

band.unit: sum (whole interior finishes-schedule package for one 800 m2 tenancy floor; unit rates are $/m2, $/m and $/package as noted)
band.basis: Component-by-component build-up from QV CostBuilder Auckland rows plus three stated allowances; GST exclusive, excluding preliminaries, margin, design and consent fees as directed. Low = sum of component lows: vinyl wall covering 13,420 + feature paint 7,412 + carpet tile 64,000 + LVT 6,300 + painted MDF substrate 1,632 + battens 5,600 + lacquer 3,400 + skirting 8,372 + smoothing compound 24,674 + wall prep allowance 2,000 + trims/protection/waste allowance 6,000 + measure/setout/out-of-hours allowance 4,000 = 146,810. High = 15,840 + 8,704 + 76,800 + 8,550 + 1,752 + 7,960 + 4,880 + 9,958 + 36,500 + 5,000 + 11,000 + 9,000 = 195,944. Midpoint 171,377 = $214/m2 over the 800 m2 NLA. Allowances carry 12,000-25,000 of the band, i.e. 8-13% - well under a third, so no main cost driver rests on an allowance. Largest lines: carpet tile 64,000-76,800 (QV rows cited), smoothing compound 24,674-36,500 (QV rows cited), each wall finish and the batten wall (QV rows or QV proxies with stated adjustments). Fetched web pages were used only as market cross-checks on the two floor-finish lines and no band amount rests on a web figure. Main swings: carpet tile (a value tile at the NZ contract-advertised $49/sqm would take ~$32k off the low end), the 0.55 mm wear-layer LVT (weakest proxy, +40-90% adjustment applied), the smoothing compound (range $33.8-$50/m2 across 730 m2) and the batten wall (labour-dominant, no direct QV row). All QV rows are unreviewed and should be caveated in the cost plan.

Working estimate band for the whole six-finish schedule on one 800 m2 NLA tenancy floor, Auckland CBD. Sum of the component lows is $141,868 and of the highs $195,430, rounded to $142,000-$195,000; midpoint $168,650, which is $211/m2 over the 800 m2 NLA. Built from QV CostBuilder rows priced in Auckland (unreviewed - cited above with the substitution or adjustment stated) plus two labelled allowances; GST exclusive, and excluding preliminaries, margin, design and consent fees, base-build linings and stopping, ceilings, joinery, existing-finish removal and make-good per the fixed scope. Allowances total $5,500-$13,300, about 6% of the midpoint - well under a third, so the band is not allowance-driven. Largest component is carpet tile at about 44% of the midpoint, resting on QV's heavy-duty loose-laid nylon tile rows; latex smoothing compound is 18% and the vinyl wall covering 9%. Main swings: carpet tile rate (each $8/m2 = $5,100 on the package), latex build depth (0.5mm vs 3mm = $11,800), batten density on the 24 m2 feature wall, and the after-hours share. Cross-check against QV's own office benchmarks: 'Renovations to Existing Offices' basic standard with HVAC is AKL 630-780/m2 of floor area including services, and 'Fit Out to Offices' basic standard finishes is AKL 690-790/m2 - this finishes-only package at $211/m2 sits below those because it carries no partitions, ceilings or services. This is a cost-plan band, not a certified price; QV rates are unreviewed and the quantities for transitions and the after-hours share are my own estimates.

band.unit: sum (whole finishes-schedule package, one tenancy floor, 800 m2 NLA)
band.basis: Sum of the cited QV rows and fetched vendor pages above plus four labelled allowances. Adds to $118,561 low and $189,357 high; midpoint $154,000, which is $192/m2 over the 800 m2 NLA. Auckland (AKL) column used throughout, GST exclusive, no preliminaries, margin or fees. Carpet tile ($41,600-72,960) is the dominant line and the biggest single swing; latex smoothing compound ($24,674-36,500) is second and is the line most understated by the schedule's own build-up; vinyl wall covering ($15,840-23,540) is third. The main cost drivers all rest on cited QV rows or a fetched vendor page, but the QV rows are unreviewed and three of them are performance-class proxies (Class 33 carpet, Type II 20 oz wall vinyl, 42x19 battens at 16.7 lin m/m2), and the out-of-hours loading is judgement, so confidence is medium and the band is deliberately wide. Not a certified price.
